table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Date=P.Date,
	PatientCode=P.PatientCode,
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	PatientName = P.Name,
	FHName = P.FName,
	Gender = CASE P.Gender WHEN 'M' THEN 'Male' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Female' ELSE ' ' END,
	Age = ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeYears))) + ' yrs ','') + ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeMonths))) + ' mon ','') + ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeDays))) + ' days ',''),
	Address1=P.Address1,
	DoctCode = P.DoctCode,
	ConsultanctFirstContact=PFC.DoctCode,
	AdmissionCode=P.AdmissionCode,
	ChestPain=CASE WHEN PC.ChestPain ='Y' THEN 'Typical Chest Pain: ' + CASE WHEN PC.ChestpainSince > 0 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(PC.ChestpainSince))) ELSE '' END + ' ' + CASE PC.ChestPainTimeUnit WHEN 'D' THEN 'Days' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Weeks' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Months' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yrs' WHEN 'H' THEN 'Hrs' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Min' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END,
	ChestPainATypical=CASE WHEN PC.ChestPainATypical ='Y' THEN 'ATypical Chest Pain: ' + CASE WHEN PC.ChestPainATypicalSince > 0 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(PC.ChestPainATypicalSince))) ELSE '' END + ' ' + CASE PC.ChestPainATypicalTimeUnit WHEN 'D' THEN 'Days' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Weeks' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Months' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yrs' WHEN 'H' THEN 'Hrs' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Min' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END,
	ShortnessofBreath=CASE WHEN PC.ShortnessofBreath ='Y' THEN 'Shortness of Breath: ' + CASE WHEN PC.ShortnessofBreathSince > 0 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(PC.ShortnessofBreathSince))) ELSE '' END + ' ' + CASE PC.ShortnessofBreathTimeUnit WHEN 'D' THEN 'Days' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Weeks' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Months' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yrs' WHEN 'H' THEN 'Hrs' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Min' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END,
	RelievedAtRestIncreaseOnExertion=CASE WHEN PC.RelievedAtRestIncreaseOnExertion ='Y' THEN 'Relieved At Rest, Increase On Exertion: ' + CASE WHEN PC.RelievedAtRestIncreaseOnExertionSince > 0 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(PC.RelievedAtRestIncreaseOnExertionSince))) ELSE '' END + ' ' + CASE PC.RelievedAtRestIncreaseOnExertionTimeUnit WHEN 'D' THEN 'Days' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Weeks' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Months' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yrs' WHEN 'H' THEN 'Hrs' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Min' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END,
	ChestDiscomfort=CASE WHEN PC.ChestDiscomfort='Y' THEN 'Un-Explained Chest Discomfort: ' + CASE WHEN PC.ChestDiscomfortSince > 0 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(PC.ChestDiscomfortSince))) ELSE '' END + ' ' + CASE PC.ChestDiscomforttimeUnit WHEN 'D' THEN 'Days' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Weeks' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Months' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yrs' WHEN 'H' THEN 'Hrs' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Min' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END,
	ChestHeavinessTightnessOnExertion=CASE WHEN PC.ChestHeavinessTightnessOnExertion='Y' THEN 'Chest Heaviness & Tightness On Exertion: ' + CASE WHEN PC.ChestHeavinessTightnessOnExertionFor > 0 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(PC.ChestHeavinessTightnessOnExertionFor))) ELSE '' END + ' ' + CASE PC.ChestHeavinessTightnessOnExertionTimeUnit WHEN 'D' THEN 'Days' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Weeks' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Months' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yrs' WHEN 'H' THEN 'Hrs' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Min' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END,
	PressureLikeSymtomsInChest=CASE WHEN PC.PressureLikeSymtomsInChest='Y' THEN 'Pressure Like Symptoms In Chest: ' + CASE WHEN PC.PressureLikeSymtomsInChestSince > 0 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(PC.PressureLikeSymtomsInChestSince))) ELSE '' END + ' ' + CASE PC.PressureLikeSymtomsInChestTimeUnit WHEN 'D' THEN 'Days' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Weeks' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Months' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yrs' WHEN 'H' THEN 'Hrs' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Min' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END,
	TypicalAnginaFunctionalClass=CASE WHEN PC.TypicalAnginaFunctionalClass='Y' THEN 'Typical Angina NYHA Functional Class: ' +

		CASE WHEN PC.Type3AnginaFunctionalClass='Y' THEN 'III,' ELSE '' END +
		CASE WHEN PC.Type4AnginaFunctionalClass='Y' THEN 'IV,' ELSE '' END + ' ' +

		CASE PC.TypicalAnginaFunctionalClassTimeUnit WHEN 'D' THEN 'Days' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Weeks' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Months' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yrs' WHEN 'H' THEN 'Hrs' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Min' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END,

	PatientPresentation=CASE WHEN PC.PatientPresentation = 'Y' THEN 'Presented in Un-Conscious & Collapsed State: ' + ISNULL(PC.PatientPresentationDetails,'') ELSE '' END,
	Palpitations=CASE WHEN PC.Palpitations='Y' THEN 'Palpitations: ' + CASE WHEN PC.PalpitationsSince > 0 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(PC.PalpitationsSince))) ELSE '' END + ' ' + CASE PC.PalpitationsTimeUnit WHEN 'D' THEN 'Days' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Weeks' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Months' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yrs' WHEN 'H' THEN 'Hrs' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Min' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END,

	PaininAbdomen=CASE WHEN PC.PaininAbdomen='Y' THEN 'Abdomen: ' + CASE WHEN PC.PaininAbdomenSince > 0 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(PC.PaininAbdomenSince))) ELSE '' END + ' ' + CASE PC.PaininAbdomenTimeUnit WHEN 'D' THEN 'Days' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Weeks' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Months' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yrs' WHEN 'H' THEN 'Hrs' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Min' ELSE '' END ELSE '' END,

	ProvisionalDiagnosis = PD.ProvisionalDiagnosis,
	PD_Details = PD.Details,
	DischargeRefferalCode=P.DischargeRefferalCode, 
	DischargeRefferal = (SELECT DR.Name FROM DischargeRefferal DR WHERE DR.DischargeRefferalCode = P.DischargeRefferalCode),
	DischargeNotes=P.DischargeNotes
	
FROM 
	(SELECT Patient.PatientCode, Patient.Name, Patient.RegNo, Patient.FName, Patient.Date, Patient.AgeYears, Patient.AgeMonths, Patient.AgeDays, Patient.DOB, Patient.Address1, Patient.Gender, Patient.DoctCode,
		A.AdmissionCode, AdmissionDate=A.Date, Discharged=A.Discharged, DischargedOn=A.DischargedOn, DischargeRefferalCode, DischargeNotes
	FROM PatientAdmission A, Patient 
	WHERE A.AdmissionCode IN (:ai_code) AND 
		A.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode) P
	LEFT OUTER JOIN PatientFirstContact PFC ON (P.PatientCode = PFC.PatientCode AND P.AdmissionCode=PFC.AdmissionCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN PC ON (P.PatientCode = PC.PatientCode AND P.AdmissionCode=PC.AdmissionCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN GPE ON (P.PatientCode = GPE.PatientCode AND P.AdmissionCode=GPE.AdmissionCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN SE ON (P.PatientCode = SE.PatientCode AND P.AdmissionCode=SE.AdmissionCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN LabInvestRec AS LIR ON (P.PatientCode = LIR.PatientCode AND P.AdmissionCode=LIR.AdmissionCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ProvDiag PD ON (P.PatientCode = PD.PatientCode AND P.AdmissionCode=PD.AdmissionCode)
ORDER BY
	P.PatientCode
